experiments.title: LUT3 circuit tiles
experiments.question: Can a learned local decision become a few truth-table instructions rather than a feature tensor?
experiments.mechanism: Represent 32 positions per Boolean plane. Build a typed three-input gate DAG over exact bases, validity, strand and prior threshold masks; emit several planes for later learned mixing. Compile fixed truth tables into LOP3 immediates. Keep weights/truth-table provenance beside the circuit.
experiments.volta_mapping: LOP3, shifts, bitwise masks, register reuse; one lane may own 32 biological positions rather than one.
experiments.semantic_limit: A Boolean gate cannot retain arbitrary floating magnitude. Different masks must refer to the same coordinate domain; complements are masked by validity.
experiments.minimum_probe: Compare all eight truth-table rows and a 31/32-base seam; keep exact source coordinates.

experiments.title: Carry-plane evidence counters
experiments.question: Can many predicates accumulate graded evidence without unpacking each genomic position?

experiments.volta_mapping: LOP3 carry compositions, XOR/AND, POPC only when a scalar total is needed.
experiments.semantic_limit: Carry propagation depth and register pressure grow with precision. Overflow and saturation policies are part of the operator.
experiments.minimum_probe: Fifteen supports reach 15 in four planes; a sixteenth sets an explicit overflow mask.

experiments.title: A warp is a transition function
experiments.question: Can one warp represent what a region does for every possible entry state?
experiments.mechanism: Let lane s hold T(s) for a 32-state machine. A concatenated region stores R(L(s)); fetching lane L(s) from the right table is a shuffle. Build a hierarchy of these maps, with explicit state vocabulary and reset semantics. Query a root map without traversing every base.
experiments.volta_mapping: One SHFL per scalar state-map composition; identity padding and warp-uniform execution.
experiments.semantic_limit: Thirty-two states are a bounded model class, not a universal biological state. Table bytes must be amortized over useful regions and repeated queries.

experiments.question: Can an effect summary retain enough evidence to explain its outputs?
experiments.mechanism: Augment each possible entry state with an emitted-count monoid and an optional first/last witness. Compose counts as cL(s)+cR(TL(s)); transform witnesses into parent coordinates. Defer full event reconstruction to a source revisit when bounded summaries cannot hold it.

experiments.title: Permutation-diagonal affine effects
experiments.question: Can CarryFold mix channels while keeping a small composition algebra?
experiments.mechanism: Represent h_out[i]=d[i]*h_in[p[i]]+b[i]. Compose permutations, scales and offsets using the derived monomial-affine rule. This introduces channel re-routing while remaining closed; apply nonlinearities only at explicitly represented breaks in the algebra.

experiments.semantic_limit: Closure is mathematical; floating parenthesization changes rounding. Arbitrary nonlinear or dense updates do not remain monomial.

experiments.question: Can a middle ground between diagonal scans and dense state matrices preserve useful mixing?

experiments.volta_mapping: Constant folding, LUT/program packing, cached prepared kernels, uniform guard evaluation.
experiments.semantic_limit: A cached result depends on its context, not just raw sequence. Never convert an approximate learned guess into an exact static biological fact.
experiments.minimum_probe: Change a weight or query version and show the specialized result is not silently reused.

experiments.title: Repeat quotient plus contextual residual
experiments.question: Can identical sequence reuse work without pretending identical sequence has identical function?
experiments.mechanism: Intern verified exact substrings or hierarchical child tuples. Share their context-independent sequence effects, then attach per-occurrence context/state residuals and source maps. Explore a DAG whose nodes represent shared content and whose edges retain occurrence context.
experiments.volta_mapping: Hash nomination plus exact comparison, sorted child tuples, coalesced shared descriptors.
experiments.semantic_limit: Hash equality is not identity. Local sequence reuse does not justify reusing a context-dependent biological answer.
experiments.minimum_probe: Two identical strings receive one content ID but remain separate occurrences with different state versions; an N-bearing string stays distinct.

experiments.title: Variant-driven dirty cones
experiments.question: Can a small sequence edit change only the computation it actually affects?
experiments.mechanism: Maintain reverse dependencies from exact chunks to effects, partitions, posting memberships and query answers. On an edit, invalidate the affected value cone and structural memberships, then recompute to a fixed point or bounded wave frontier.
experiments.volta_mapping: Bitset dirty flags, frontier scan/compaction, versioned arrays and sparse work queues.
experiments.semantic_limit: A local edit can change a global routing key or learned boundary far away. The dirty cone may be large; do not claim constant-time variant scoring.
experiments.minimum_probe: An edited leaf invalidates ancestors plus an affected directory membership, but preserves a demonstrably independent sibling.

experiments.title: Query-support memoization
experiments.question: Can a remembered answer declare exactly what changes would invalidate it?
experiments.mechanism: Cache answers with their query, sequence, weight, cell-state and representation versions plus an exact or conservative dependency support set. Reuse only when both identity and support checks permit it. Distinguish result caches from cached computation plans.
experiments.volta_mapping: Compact version tuples, support masks/intervals, hash lookup and batched validation.
experiments.semantic_limit: An attention or pooling answer may depend on negative evidence from many inspected regions; positive hits alone understate support.
experiments.minimum_probe: An edit outside a true support set preserves a result; changing query or weights invalidates it.

experiments.title: Grammar-compressed effect reuse
experiments.question: Can repeated sequence phrases share their compositional effects at several scales?
experiments.mechanism: Infer a small repeated-phrase grammar or child-pair dictionary, then cache E05/E09 effects on grammar nodes. Derive per-occurrence source spans separately. Compare a static grammar pass with incremental chunk-pair interning rather than requiring a whole-genome parse first.
experiments.volta_mapping: Integer child IDs, hash/sort interning, postorder effect composition, compact DAG traversal.
experiments.semantic_limit: Grammar compression discovers repeated syntax, not functional modules. Building the grammar and expanding occurrences are charged work.
experiments.minimum_probe: A repeated phrase appears in two contexts; its local effect is shared while occurrence provenance stays distinct.

experiments.title: Competing parse forests
experiments.question: Can the encoder postpone a bad boundary decision instead of irreversibly collapsing alternatives?
experiments.mechanism: Keep a small beam of alternative segmentations or local grammar states, sharing common prefixes and exact source references. Higher-level queries prune or refine alternatives; use a bounded packed forest rather than copying the entire sequence representation.
experiments.volta_mapping: Small state masks, lane-per-hypothesis tables, compact backpointers and uniform beam updates.
experiments.semantic_limit: A beam is approximate and can discard the correct interpretation. Its scores are not automatically posterior probabilities.
experiments.minimum_probe: A deliberately ambiguous boundary has two valid interpretations; a later query resolves them differently.

experiments.title: Role-bound binary routing sketches
experiments.question: Can order and role travel cheaply in a bit vector before rich floating computation?
experiments.mechanism: Assign codes to local objects, bind role tags with XOR and position-dependent permutation, and bundle into a sketch with explicit collision risk. Use the sketch for nomination only; retain exact supports and a richer floating sidecar for final decisions.
experiments.volta_mapping: XOR, rotations/permutations, POPC distance, bit-sliced majority counters.
experiments.semantic_limit: Bundling is lossy; XOR without role/order binding can cancel repetitions. No claim that a random binary code is a sufficient biological embedding.
experiments.minimum_probe: AB and BA differ under role binding, while deliberately constructed sketch collisions trigger exact verification.

experiments.title: Question-specific summary portfolios
experiments.question: Can different future questions receive different compact summaries of the same region?
experiments.mechanism: Maintain a portfolio: counts for abundance questions, effects for state propagation, extrema/bounds for pruning and small learned vectors for similarity. Queries select the representation they need; unsupported questions cause source replay rather than forced use of one universal vector.

experiments.semantic_limit: Multiple summaries cost memory. Sufficiency is stated per question family, not globally for biology.

experiments.title: Counterexample-guided resolution
experiments.question: Can failed questions teach the hierarchy where it was too coarse?
experiments.mechanism: Search for query pairs or sequence perturbations whose different target answers collapse to the same coarse representation. experiments.title: Boundary-port response operators
experiments.question: Can a region expose a few ways it can interact with the rest of the system instead of all its interior state?
experiments.mechanism: Give a synthetic regional system a small set of ports and eliminate internal variables to form a response map. experiments.title: Learned multigrid correction
experiments.question: Can coarse context repair fine representations rather than merely summarize them?

experiments.title: Hyperedge rendezvous and factor joins
experiments.question: Can meaningful multi-object combinations be found without generating every pair first?
experiments.mechanism: Represent a candidate mechanism as a small factor with typed roles. Use inverted postings and mask intersections to fill compatible roles, then evaluate only surviving tuples. Preserve a factorized relation when expanding every hyperedge would be wasteful.

experiments.title: Counterfactual packet worlds
experiments.question: Can alternative sequences or cellular conditions share almost all their execution?

experiments.title: Residency and recomputation choreography
experiments.question: Can information movement become part of the representation rather than an afterthought?
experiments.mechanism: For a fixed semantic operator, create register-recomputed, shared-staged and global-materialized variants. Fuse cheap sequence predicates into the consumer when this avoids a full plane stream; keep a resident plane form when repeated questions justify it.
